notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
The following has been added
1- New cars with and without a trailer
2- Modifying and improving the map
3- Adding new area
4- Improving the transportation system and collecting resources
5- Improve frame rate

tags.feature: 1- New cars with and without a trailer

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
An update fixes technical problems and also adds and improves systems and gameplay. 
1- Adding more building elements, for example, new houses and an animal farm
2- Adding a system for carrying the item by hand
3- Improving the animal system, where you can now raise and care for animals
4- Improving the game world in general
5- Improving the user experience. Now you can play the game with high quality and higher frame rates
